approval.description: Isolated approval windows: read the native redacted request and decide it once; no engine, filesystem, shell, events or window creation.

main.description: Main UI: filtered engine requests and native folder selection; conversation-bound raster image reads; opening links inside the chosen folder or in the browser; answering the permission request shown in its conversation (the host accepts only that one); names of subfolders for «Add project» (never files); no reading of approval windows, general files, shell or window creation.
